name: Rotonium
description: Rotonium is an Italian deep-tech startup developing room-temperature photonic quantum computers using single-photon qudit technology. Based in Padua and backed by CDP Venture Capital, the company builds silicon photonics components that enable compact quantum systems operable on Earth, in the air, and in space without cryogenic cooling.

products.name: Photonic Qudit Processor
products.description: Room-temperature silicon photonics quantum processor using single-photon qudit technology, operable without cryogenic cooling

highlights: Room-temperature operation eliminates need for expensive cryogenic infrastructure
Compact quantum systems designed for deployment on Earth, in air, and in space
Backed by CDP Venture Capital with EUR 1M+ seed funding

news.title: Quantum computing in space, Rotonium raises EUR 1 million
news.excerpt: The deeptech startup born in Friuli Venezia Giulia and incubated at Le Village in Padua receives funding from CDP VC and Obloo Ventures. Founded in 2022, Rotonium aims to decentralise quantum computing through single-photon technology enabling room-temperature operation.

news.title: Rotonium Raises €1 Million in Seed Funding to Take Quantum Computers Into Space
news.excerpt: Italian deep-tech startup Rotonium secured €1 million in seed investment underwritten by Galaxia and CDP Venture Capital's Tech Transfer Fund to advance quantum computing research.
